summary: This directory centralizes the definitions, metadata structures, and configuration types required for handling file system operations, transport configurations, and file filtering criteria within the application.
responsibilities: Define metadata structures for file transport operations
Specify filtering criteria and comparison logic for file system processing
Provide standardized type definitions for file archiving and information handling
relationships: File metadata serves as the foundational data structure for transport configuration and filtering logic.
Filtering criteria define the constraints applied during file transport operations.
Archive formats specify the supported methods for compressing or packaging file information.
designDecisions: Centralized type definitions for consistent cross-module file handling
Separation of concerns between metadata representation and operational logic
Use of typed constants to restrict file filtering and comparison options
